**Repaired finding submitted: deviation (INDEMN, critical), preferred level.**

Repair made in response to the verifier:

- **Data-breach limb (iii) broadened in operative language:** now "any unauthorized access to, use or disclosure caused by TrueLink of Client Content, Credit Data **or any other data of Client, its affiliates or their respective customers that is provided to, transmitted through or processed by TrueLink**". The trigger therefore no longer depends on the narrow § 1(d) Credit Data definition (raw repository data ≥31 days old/archived and not combined with Client Proprietary Information), so live borrower credit data and data combined with Client Proprietary Information are inside the indemnity.
- **Dangling-reference check completed:** "Interface" and "Support Services" are defined in the recitals (p0004), "Hosting Services" in § 3 (p0030), "Client Content" in § 1(b) and "Credit Data" in § 1(d) — limb (i) and limb (iii) leave no undefined terms.
- **Unchanged elements:** defend-and-indemnify running to Client and affiliates, IP infringement/misappropriation, TrueLink breach of law, gross negligence/wilful misconduct, and the notice / control of defence / reasonable cooperation procedure; op 1 still limits our indemnity to Client Content plus our own breach of law with the "the Web Site or" hook deleted.
- No fallback-only terms (procure/modify/replace, refund, 3× super-cap) were added since we are proceeding at preferred; the § 12 cap (Sections 3, 4, 7, 11) and existing § 12(b) indemnity remain intact. Redline validated ok:true with minimality satisfied.
